correctness.rationale: For exact-distance-two concepts on the binary cube, translation changes any positive root branch into the weight-two vectors, which are the edges of K_d. A query of support size 0/2/4 induces respectively all edges/a two-vertex cut/the six edges of an induced K_4; other weights induce no positive edges. Within a K_{2,m} cut, only tests with one fixed hub and one outside vertex can have a positive branch large enough for rank four. Such a branch is a punctured star plus one opposite edge, and every further test has one side with at most three hypotheses, ruling out depth three there. Therefore K_{2,m} has dimension at most 3, the weight-two layer at most 4, and the full class at most 5. Complement twins give the rank-2 ceiling in d=4; size C(d,2) yields d=1,2,3,5,6 upper bounds. Explicit complete trees with depths 1,2,4,5 at dimensions 2,3,5,7, verified by the adjacent independent Python checker, and zero-padding prove all lower bounds. The script separately confirms dimensions one through seven and the 5-dimensional VC=3 comparison; finite execution is not used as the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Primary full-text material in arXiv:2007.16042v1 concerns VC dimension for Hamming graph distance-one edge neighborhoods; its Section 4 distance-two neighborhood observations do not bound adaptive complete binary mistake trees for the distance-two relation. The primary text of arXiv:2108.05569 describes generic Littlestone definitions and stability equivalences, not this exact family. A preceding result with identifier aa804f0c-6690-4ad3-81cd-ec9a2ad5d772 gives the exact ordinary VC dimension for the same binary radius-two shell, but VC dimension is a different parameter and in d=5 differs (3 versus 4); it neither states nor implies the adaptive formula. Search results on Hamming two-shells predominantly concerned Turán constants, spectral or topological invariants. The literature comparisons establish no known statement that implies the new all-dimensional Littlestone formula. Alternative naming and undiscovered priority remain risks.
residual_risks: A published priority claim may exist under alternative halved-cube/online-special-tree/thicket terminology not discovered by these searches.

value.rationale: This is the exact optimal deterministic realizable online mistake bound for a natural binary association-scheme relation, with a sharp dimension-independent ceiling and all finite transition points. The central two-star reduction is a structural upper-bound lemma, not just a table enumeration. The d=5 jump from two to four and strict difference between VC and adaptive Littlestone rank provide a concrete conceptual reason this invariant is worth calculating. The result makes no unsupported claim about randomization, higher radii, or downstream theorems.
